slices.focus: Tasha implements tighter controls: first-contact documentation, checklist, and weekly reconciliation
slices.summary: After the complaint, Tasha redesigns the bereavement packet with a required first-contact documentation field, a one-page handoff checklist that follows referrals between teams, and a weekly reconciliation comparing chaplain referrals against the bereavement list. She walks staff through the new process using anonymized examples from the missed case. The agent helps her plan a follow-up huddle for 'awkward little questions,' distinguish between the coworker who says 'every family is different' (respond: 'different support plan, same documentation spine'), and prioritize checking whether people actually used the first-contact field before building the reconciliation template.
open_loops: Follow-up huddle for staff questions — scheduled but not held
Check first-contact field usage from day one — priority task
Build reconciliation template — deferred until live behavior is assessed
Running change log (what changed, why, what question triggered it) — started
decisions: Tasha is now overseeing a tighter bereavement intake and reconciliation process with required first-contact documentatio
